canon_traps.text: Kaito Arashima (crew archer, cable-bow, Stand Horizon Breaker) is NOT Kaito Serizawa (Tetsu Gym regular, Jovian's rematch). Always the full name; never just "Kaito".
Kurokawa is the syndicate, not a district; scenes are in Kobuncho. Say "the Kurokawa syndicate" or "Kurokawa men".
Keito Takeda is excluded from prompts (user); write "Keito is absent today" if a scene needs him.
Name Shun in prompts: the engine garbles him as "Saturday" (a 16-year-old Rikona keeps watch over).

"Safehouse" meant Club Lumiere (the crew's OWNED base, jointly Jovian's and Jostin's). The gym storage-room shelter is the working HQ (built t461-t462); a lens-free room is planned at 4-4. The 70% raid fund stays locked with Haruto; Rin releases draws.

Multiple Daigos (Daigo Renjiro the boss; Daigo Kurosawa; the student Daigo) and two Renjis (Renji Kuroba, Anya's enforcer student): always the full name. Do not develop Daigo Renjiro directly in Act 2.
Nobu has real tech and comms skill beyond Dead Air and Drone Override (traces phones, loops feeds, registries); never pre-fail his loop in a prompt.
Eagle Vision is Jostin's, not Jovian's; it reads hostility and tension, not thoughts or text.
Rikona is NOT in the crew and was not at the Lumiere table; she helps with one case only. Joining needs an explicit ask and her yes. She is a teenager: no romance.
Reiko speaks calm and slow with pauses; a loud shout is out of voice. Recruiting is the heads' call (Jovian: Spearhead seats; Jostin: Hearth seats); Reiko screens only if asked.
Student crew: Jostin, Jovian, Haruto, Nobu, Mikoto, Hana, Ayame (Jostin is a full student). Not students: Reiko, Kaito Arashima, Yuzuki (clinic shadowing), Rin, Maki, the hostesses.
Kaito Arashima's gear is a cable-bow (a disguised street-photography rig), not a camera rig; at Kagero he held the front door, not the second floor.

Never correct extra AI-written lines or actions for Jostin and Jovian (the user likes them); still correct wrong facts. Player-declared power unlocks are risky attempts, not facts; NPCs know only what they observed; the game's own turn counter is authoritative.
